_comment: OPStack manifest-driven test expectations. Documents known divergences from standard Ethereum execution.
_policy: Skip entries that fail due to OPStack fee model or execution path differences.

_gap_catalog.G1: Fee model divergence — baseFee routed to OP_BASE_FEE_RECIPIENT instead of burned.
_gap_catalog.G2: Nonce tracking — OPStack path does not write sender nonce increment to stateDiff.
_gap_catalog.G4: Precompile behavior difference — OPStack precompile routing differs from evmone built-in precompiles.
_gap_catalog.G5: Gas schedule difference — OPStack intrinsic gas calculation differs from standard Ethereum.
_gap_catalog.G8: Authorization cost — EIP-7702 authorization processing costs may differ in OPStack path.
